description: This map displays false-colour infrared satellite imagery of Täby, Sweden. The imagery shows healthy vegetation in shades of bright red, with urban or built-up areas appearing in blue and grey tones. A dark, winding feature represents a river. A specific linear area is highlighted by a turquoise polygon and labelled "1220". This delineated area corresponds to a railway and its associated land, which includes railway tracks, facilities, and service areas, running through a built-up zone parallel to the river. Other land cover units are outlined by thin green lines. The label "1220" refers to the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) nomenclature category "1.2.2 Railways and associated land", which has a minimum mapping width (MMW) of ≥ 10m and includes railway facilities and closed-down rails where infrastructure is still visible. The image is credited to K. Larsson.
